requirements.requirement: There is an article published between 2019 and 2021, inclusive.
The article was written by two authors.
The first author of the article participated in 2018 in a conference that took place in Aalborg.
The article mentions that, up to the time of publishing, the corresponding author was affiliated with a university.
That university was in 2023 among the 130 best universities in the world for 2024 according to the QS World University ranking.
The article discusses a phenomenon that involves images and has been addressed from a Systemic Functional Linguistics perspective.
The authors of the article suggest that a different framework, which is mentioned in the first keyword of the article, may allow the identification of new elements related to the phenomenon.
The second keyword in the article is identified.
